## Goal

Produce the versioned ReviewReport shared by the window, MCP and export, ranking objects by size weighted by their project's last source activity and revalidating each item before it is shown as present.

## Deliverables

- ReviewReport model and store
- Ranking and revalidation

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-622-01` — ReviewReport carries scope, start and completion times, coverage, status and limitations, and per item a privacy-shaped path, kind, project, allocated bytes, reclaimable estimate or unknown, last source activity, verification time, recreate class, reasons to review and reasons to keep; item states are present-verified, stale, partial or unknown; there is no safe-to-delete field; repositories appear only as live-state context, never as candidates.
- `AC-TASK-622-02` — Ranking uses only recorded inputs (size and last source activity); every item is revalidated against its live path and identity before being shown present; a report holds at most 2,000 items and at most 20 reports are retained.

## Required Evidence
